Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, who had
entered the intersection from a cross street. Upon arrival, the responding officer observed the passenger-side and
driver-side damage to both vehicles and found it consistent with a broadside collision of this type. Witnesses at the
scene stated that the crash occurred as Driver 1 described it, and photographs taken on scene were consistent with
those accounts. Driver 2 also gave a statement confirming the sequence of events. Officers verified that Passenger
was seated in the vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported neck and back pain and was transported for
evaluation. The force of the impact appeared sufficient to produce the type of soft tissue injury described. No prior
damage to the vehicle was noted by the responding officer, and records indicate Driver 1 is listed as a named driver
on the policy covering the vehicle.
</page>
